title: Fix with drag-lint (VS Code and RAD Studio)
summary: Fix the finding at the cursor, all of one rule, or every fixable finding in a file: VS Code code actions and menus, plus a RAD Studio menu entry
intro: Read this when you want drag-lint to apply its own deterministic fix instead of editing by hand. In VS Code, use the light bulb (`Fix: <rule>`, `drag-lint: fix all <rule> in file`, `drag-lint: fix all fixable in file`), right-click in the editor or on a Problems entry and choose Fix with drag-lint, or let editor.codeActionsOnSave run source.fixAll.drag-lint. In RAD Studio, put the caret on the finding, right-click in the editor, open the drag-lint submenu and choose Fix with drag-lint (finding at cursor).

surfaces.caption: drag-lint > Fix with drag-lint (finding at cursor)
steps: Put the caret on a line that shows a drag-lint finding
Right-click in the editor, open the drag-lint submenu and choose Fix with drag-lint (finding at cursor)
Answer Yes to apply the fix, No to preview it
